verdict.rationale: Puzzle's API docs describe a dedicated sandbox server separate from the production server, with test-prefixed client credentials, so integrators can test without touching production data. Access is manual: sandbox credentials must be requested by email and are not self-serve. missing for 10: self-serve sandbox provisioning, in-depth sandbox documentation (data seeding, reset, parity with production), a sandbox or test mode for the MCP agent surface, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Sandbox Server: https://staging.southparkdata.com / Production Server: https://api.puzzle.io
